notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only source for the lookout itself is the state tower index, which gives a name, county, coordinates and elevation. No build date, builder, design, staffing, fires, fate or access was found in two web searches or the cached pages, and the Camden County cache says nothing about a tower. The index's elevation column is read as feet, which matches the metre value in the record. Story is about 112 words, a little under the 120-word target for thin evidence; beyond the index entry it carries only county context, so it is not padded further. Georgia Forestry Commission records are the likeliest next source.
